summary: Mitsutoshi Moriguchi works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He completed his doctoral studies at Taisho University, where he also served as a lecturer (attested 1989–1995).
Mitsuyo Demoto is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Indology who studied at Kyoto University. She held a post at the University of Marburg (attested 2024).

Mitsuyoshi Saegusa was a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy. Educated at the University of Tokyo, Kokugakuin University, and the University of Munich under Helmut Hoffmann, he was a professor at Tsukuba and Nihon universities and director of Eastern Institute.

Mitsuyuki Ishida was a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Ryukoku University from ~1931 to 1934. He later served as a teacher and professor at Ryukoku University (~1959–1980) and as a professor at Shitennoji University (attested 1976).

Mittal Trivedi specializes in Indology and linguistics. After earning an Acharya degree at Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda (2017–2019), Trivedi held a doctoral position at the University of Cagliari from 2020 to 2024.
Miyako Notake specializes in Indology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy, and has served as a part-time lecturer at Waseda University (attested 2015 and 2026).
Miyoko Nakano is a Sinologist who studied at Hokkaido University from ~1952 to 1956 and subsequently held a post there from ~1967 to 1996.

Mizuho Okita specializes in Indology and religious studies. She earned a BA at Tokai University under Katsuhiko Kamimura, completed doctoral studies at Gakushuin University under Atsuhiko Yoshida, and served as a part-time lecturer at Meisei University (attested 2008).
Mizumaro Ishida was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Japanology who served as a professor at Tokai University (attested in 1976 and 1987).
Mohammad Ashraf Dar is a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology. He earned a Master of Philosophy at Vikram University, where he also held a position as a research scholar (attested 2014).
Mohammad Habib was an Indologist and historian who studied at the University of Allahabad, Aligarh Muslim University (~1912–1916), and New College (~1916–1920).

Mohan G. Dhadphale is a scholar in Indology and Buddhist studies. He held a professorship at Tilak Maharashtra Vidyapeeth (attested 2000) and served as editor of the Annals at the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute (attested 2003).
Mokurai Shimaji was a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies who studied under Chō Sanshū. He served as Geschäftsführer at Nishi Hongan-ji (1870) and as head priest at Gankyo-ji (1892–1905).

Mona Schrempf is a scholar of Tibetology and religious studies who completed her doctorate at the Free University of Berlin in 2001. In 2006, she was attested as a research fellow at Humboldt University and a part-time teacher at Heidelberg.

Monia Chies specializes in Tibetology and religious studies. She earned a master's degree at Ca' Foscari University of Venice in 2011 and held a PhD candidate position at Humboldt University of Berlin in 2013.

Monica Esposito was a scholar of Sinology and religious studies. Educated at Ca' Foscari, Fudan, Ghent, and Paris Diderot, she completed postdoctoral studies at Ca' Foscari, Sorbonne, and Kansai, later serving as associate professor at Kyoto University in 2003.

Monica L. Smith is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology. She studied at the University of Michigan (~1991–1997), worked at the University of Pittsburgh (2000–2002), and became a professor at the University of California, Los Angeles in 2002.

Monier Monier-Williams was an Indologist and linguist who studied at Oxford under Horace Hayman Wilson. He taught at East India Company College and Cheltenham College before serving as Oxford's Boden Professor of Sanskrit from 1860 to 1887.

Monika Boehm-Tettelbach is an Indologist and linguist. She earned her doctorate under Heinz-Jürgen Pinnow at the Free University of Berlin, habilitated at Bonn, and held professorships at Bonn, Cologne, Bamberg (~1992–1994), and Heidelberg University (1990–2006).
Monika Nowakowska is a scholar in Indology and philosophy who has held posts in the Faculty of Oriental Studies' Chair of South Asian Studies at the University of Warsaw (attested 2010 and 2026).
